label: Uneasy
summary: The Iran war still sets the tone. Mines set tankers on fire in the Strait of Hormuz, and Washington said a peace deal would be extremely difficult. Tehran said the strait stays closed until its conditions are met. The UN said more than 250,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since fighting escalated. Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case. NATO is sending more patrol planes to the Black Sea after drone attacks. Floods hit Marseille, a landslide at an illegal gold mine in Colombia killed 14 people, and UN experts urged India to stop using excessive force against protesters. There were steadier notes too. Alberta rejected separation from Canada, the New Zealand-India free trade deal came into force, Jersey expanded its marine protections and The Gambia will pay reparations to victims of its former dictator. The weighted formula gave 40; no editorial adjustment.
